The '''Ansharii Caverns''' were a series of caves located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]]. After a [[Battle of Toprawa (Great Sith War)|battle]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] led by [[Barrison Draay]] were killed by an explosion in the caverns [[Ambush in the Ansharii Caverns|orchestrated]] by failed [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Haazen]] and [[Dossa]], a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Sith Minion]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].
